note: Strip back to clean signal. Removed the Reversion Triad after NVDA 1W chair test showed 20+ gold stars across a single sustained trend. The gates meant to identify exhaustion turned out to be routinely true together in trending markets. Replaced with the Sequence Rule: buy when red yellow green in three successive bars, sell when green yellow red in three successive bars, alternating cooldown so the next signal must be the opposite type. No layer gates. Backtest mirrors the same rule. Plus the gauge yellow band tightened to 48-52 so red and green dominate the readout. Plus a sandwich button in the toolbar that collapses the sidebar so the chart can take the full width and persists in fl_tg_sidebar. Strategy doc gets the deprecation note for the Reversion Tier and a new Section 10 documenting the Sequence Rule with what it catches and what it might miss.
